data.goal: Explain what the guests bring and how their tasks depend on one another.

data.situation: On Saturday, Tom put his coat over the same chair, now beside a long table. Twelve guests introduced themselves before the meal; eight had lived in the neighbourhood for years. A majority of the guests already knew the street, though they did not all know one another. Tom sat beside Mira. He told her that his close friend had moved away and that some days he barely spoke to anyone. The isolation was not easy to admit. Mira listened while he straightened the napkin in front of him. In the kitchen, Mira set a handwritten recipe card beside the pot. Her grandmother had always made this soup when relatives came round. “It is part of my cultural identity,” Mira said, tracing a faded line on the card. She did not expect anyone to know the dish already. Nora asked how it was served, and Mira showed her the bowls. Tom offered to bring them to the table, then stopped: the small counter was still covered with bags. Nora moved the bags below the counter. Tom took the bowls from the cupboard and put them in the cleared space. Only then could Mira begin to serve the soup. Their tasks were interdependent: Mira needed the cleared space and the bowls, while Tom and Nora needed her soup before they could serve the meal. Soon Tom was carrying them out one at a time, asking people where they wanted to sit. He stayed at the table after his own bowl was empty. At the door, Nora pinned up a fresh paper list for another supper. This time it asked what each person would like to bring or do. It was a small shift from inviting guests to sharing the preparation. There was recognition that the guests had ideas of their own, not just names to add to a form. Mira wrote “soup” again; Tom wrote “set the table”. Before they stepped into the street, he asked if she would like to walk home together.
data.easySummary: At the supper, Tom tells Mira that he has little company since his friend moved away. Mira brings a family recipe. Nora clears the counter, Tom brings bowls, and Mira serves soup. The next list asks everyone what they would like to contribute.
data.easySummaryZh: 晚餐上，汤姆说朋友搬走后自己缺少陪伴。米拉带来一份家庭食谱。诺拉清理台面，汤姆取碗，米拉盛汤。下一张名单问每个人愿意贡献些什么。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Of twelve guests, eight have lived here for years. Tom says that since his friend moved away, there are days when he barely speaks to anyone. Describe the group and what he tells Mira, without turning his experience into a claim about everyone.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 十二位来客中有八位已在这里住了多年。汤姆说朋友搬走后，有些日子他几乎不和任何人交谈。描述这群来客，以及他向米拉讲述的经历，不把个人经历推广到所有人。
acceptableAnswers: A majority of the guests have lived here for years. Tom describes his isolation since his friend moved away; this does not tell us how every guest feels.
checks: 只限定十二位现场来客
独居与孤立不自动等同

retrievalPrompts.cue: Mira uses a recipe from her grandmother. Nora clears the counter, Tom fetches bowls, and Mira makes the soup. Together, they want to serve supper to the guests. Explain why the recipe matters to Mira and why they need one another to finish the meal.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 米拉按祖母的食谱做汤，诺拉清理台面，汤姆取碗。他们要一起为来客端上晚餐。解释食谱为什么对米拉有意义，以及三人为何需要彼此才能完成这顿晚餐。
acceptableAnswers: The recipe is part of Mira's cultural identity. The tasks are interdependent: Mira needs the clear counter and bowls, while Tom and Nora need her soup to serve the meal.
checks: 由人物自述解释食物与家庭文化的联系

retrievalPrompts.cue: The old list asked only for names. The new one asks what each guest would like to bring or do. Explain what has changed and what the organisers now accept about their guests.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 旧名单只填姓名，新名单问每位来客想带什么或做什么。说明安排发生了什么变化，以及组织者如今接受了来客的哪些意愿。
acceptableAnswers: There is a shift towards sharing the preparation, with recognition that guests have ideas of their own.
checks: recognition为承认事实而非认出人或授奖

transferPrompt.cue: A garden group used to invite people only to watch. Now it asks which jobs they would like to do. One person brings seeds from a family tradition; another prepares the beds. Others help plant the seeds. Together, they want to grow the garden. Explain the change and why the different people need one another to complete it.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 一个社区花园小组过去只邀请人们观看，如今会问他们想做哪些工作。一人带来与家庭传统相关的种子，另一人整理花圃，其他人帮忙种植。他们要一起把花园种好。说明安排的变化，以及不同的人为何需要彼此才能完成。
acceptableAnswers: There is a shift towards sharing the work, with recognition that visitors have ideas. The tasks are interdependent. Those planting need the seeds and prepared beds; those bringing seeds and preparing beds need help with planting to complete the garden.
checks: 不推断种子代表整个国家
